question: Can fit-only backward greedy removal compress the converged programs without the accumulated out-of-sample damage caused by independent leave-one-out thresholding?

frozen_design.algorithm: From the complete converged path, evaluate every single removal, choose the lowest unit-target MSE with lexical tie-break, accept it only while cumulative MSE remains <= starting MSE + 0.005, and repeat. Never consult heldout A1 or A2 during selection.
frozen_design.evaluation: After stopping, compare complete and pruned paths on heldout A1 and A2.

predictions.pred_a_authority_reproduction_capability: Starting MSE reproduces within 1e-6; capability, banks, finiteness and maximum price pass.
predictions.pred_b_both_programs_compress: At least one component is removed from each path and the accepted final fit MSE stays within the frozen cumulative budget.
predictions.pred_c_pruned_programs_preserve_out_of_s: Pruned recovery is within 0.03 of complete recovery with donorward direction on every heldout/A2 panel.
predictions.pred_d_is_was_beats_independent_core_com: The pruned is/was path beats the four-component independent-core path on both heldout A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_e_shared_backbone_survives: MLP3, MLP4, and MLP8 remain in both pruned paths.

decision: screen seals the backward-pruned paths for tensor compilation; null preserves the prospective stopping trace without threshold repair; invalid on authority, reproduction, capability, finiteness, coverage, or price failure
